decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block FAQ material, retains the continuing Small Block prizes, and records the revised purchase allocation.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the existing automatic-wallet-transfer payout mode for the continuing Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $8 purchase allocation to the continuing Small Block prize pool; its winner count, prize amount, and trigger remain unchanged.
The prize restructuring does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, wallet provisioning, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle status.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the NFT token serial as the permanent referral code or any of its display locations.
The source decision does not alter email authentication or dashboard access for referrals, tickets, and prizes.
The removal of Big Block prizes does not alter SIWE authentication, supported user paths, or protected wallet flows.
Winner notification by email and the recorded mint and ebook-access email contents remain valid without a Big Block-specific state attribute.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute while preserving the Small Block counter and unrelated metadata.
The source decision does not change the one-ticket quantity or random-existing-holder recipient rule for mints without a referral code.

The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows Chainlink VRF applicability to SMALL_BLOCK while leaving the selection provider and fairness properties unchanged.
